name: Executive Dashboard
description: High-level KPIs and business metrics for executive leadership

native.query: SELECT SUM(total_amount_usd) as revenue FROM analytics.fact_transactions WHERE status = 'Completed' AND transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_sk) as customers FROM analytics.dim_customers WHERE is_current = TRUE
SELECT AVG(total_amount_usd) as aov FROM analytics.fact_transactions WHERE status = 'Completed' AND transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN conversion THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) as conversion_rate FROM analytics.fact_customer_sessions WHERE session_start >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT dt.full_date as date, COALESCE(SUM(ft.total_amount_usd), 0) as revenue FROM analytics.dim_time dt LEFT JOIN analytics.fact_transactions ft ON dt.date_key = ft.date_key AND ft.status = 'Completed' WHERE dt.full_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' AND dt.full_date < CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY dt.full_date ORDER BY dt.full_date

SELECT ch.channel_name, SUM(ft.total_amount_usd) as revenue FROM analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN analytics.dim_channels ch ON ft.channel_sk = ch.channel_sk WHERE ft.status = 'Completed' AND ft.transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY ch.channel_name ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT dc.customer_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT ft.customer_sk) as customers, SUM(ft.total_amount_usd) as revenue, AVG(ft.total_amount_usd) as avg_order_value FROM analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN analytics.dim_customers dc ON ft.customer_sk = dc.customer_sk WHERE ft.status = 'Completed' AND dc.is_current = TRUE AND ft.transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY dc.customer_segment ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT dp.product_name, dp.category, SUM(ft.quantity) as units_sold, SUM(ft.total_amount_usd) as revenue FROM analytics.fact_transactions ft JOIN analytics.dim_products dp ON ft.product_sk = dp.product_sk WHERE ft.status = 'Completed' AND dp.is_current = TRUE AND ft.transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY dp.product_name, dp.category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10

WITH current_period AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount_usd) as revenue FROM analytics.fact_transactions WHERE status = 'Completed' AND transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)), prior_period AS (SELECT SUM(total_amount_usd) as revenue FROM analytics.fact_transactions WHERE status = 'Completed' AND transaction_timestamp >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' AND transaction_timestamp < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year' + INTERVAL '1 month') SELECT 100.0 * (c.revenue - p.revenue) / NULLIF(p.revenue, 0) as yoy_growth FROM current_period c, prior_period p
